title.zh: 【币安：预计 45 小时后恢复提现，后续调查发现更多入侵点】
title.en: 【币安：预计 45 小时后恢复提现，后续调查发现更多入侵点】

current_state.zh: 币安安全事件后的资产补足比例升至90%，十种主要代币已100%覆盖，剩余10%为流动性较低资产；新的储备证明快照已完成，提现仍计划于11月1日恢复。
current_state.en: Coverage for assets stolen in Binance's security incident has risen to 90%, with ten major tokens fully covered and the remaining 10% in less liquid assets; a new proof-of-reserves snapshot is complete and withdrawals remain scheduled to reopen on Nov 1.

updates.title_zh: 【币安：预计 45 小时后恢复提现，后续调查发现更多入侵点】
updates.title_en: 【币安：预计 45 小时后恢复提现，后续调查发现更多入侵点】
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安表示，其对安全漏洞的调查发现，除一台被入侵的笔记本电脑外，还存在其他入侵点；已与合作伙伴冻结约30亿美元受影响资产；所有损失将由SAFU基金和公司资本承担；提现预计约45小时后恢复，充值不受影响。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance said its investigation into the security breach uncovered additional intrusion points beyond a compromised laptop, that roughly $3 billion in affected assets has been frozen with partners, that all losses will be covered by the SAFU fund and corporate capital, and that withdrawals should resume in about 45 hours while deposits remain unaffected.

updates.title_zh: 【币安：被盗资产补足比例升至 90%，提现仍计划周日恢复】
updates.title_en: 【币安：被盗资产补足比例升至 90%，提现仍计划周日恢复】
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安称被盗资产补足比例已从约80%升至90%，BTC、ETH、USDT、BNB、SOL、USDC、XRP、USD1、RLUSD与ZEC已实现100%覆盖；10月31日8:00完成新的储备证明快照，完整零知识证明预计11月3日生成；提现仍计划11月1日恢复，SAFU部分调用预计未来24小时内进行。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance said stolen-asset coverage rose from about 80% to 90%, with BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC fully covered; a new proof-of-reserves snapshot was completed on Oct 31 at 08:00, with the full zero-knowledge proof expected around Nov 3; withdrawals remain planned to reopen Nov 1, and part of the SAFU draw is expected within 24 hours.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安安全事件后的资产补足比例升至90%，十种主要代币已100%覆盖，剩余10%为流动性较低资产；新的储备证明快照已完成，提现仍计划于11月1日恢复。
updates.current_state_en: Coverage for assets stolen in Binance's security incident has risen to 90%, with ten major tokens fully covered and the remaining 10% in less liquid assets; a new proof-of-reserves snapshot is complete and withdrawals remain scheduled to reopen on Nov 1.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance said coverage for assets stolen in its security incident has climbed to 90%, with ten major tokens fully covered via SAFU, insurance and corporate funds, a fresh proof-of-reserves snapshot completed, and withdrawals still on track to reopen on November 1.
